- Security asks: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter covering interim controls, trust portal access, and completion of vendor security questionnaire (GDPR/HIPAA scope confirmation).

Action items / timeline (proposal):
1) Share most recent SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood) — attached (Marissa) — ETA: same day.
2) Provide bridge letter that addresses timeline to next Type II (Rishi) — ETA: 2 business days.
3) Invite Horizon to Redwood Trust Portal for on-demand evidence and control mappings — I will send invite today; access typically within 24 hours.
4) Vendor security questionnaire — we can either answer your doc or send our standard questionnaire (link below). Recommend Horizon send initial high-priority questions first (encryption/retention/PII handling).

Please confirm this plan and let me know if you want any additional evidence (pen test report, ISO certificates) up front. If the timeline works we’ll: (A) send SOC 2 PDF now, (B) Rishi will prepare the bridge letter, (C) send trust portal invite.
